2. Mr. Pratiroop Pandey, learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. The present C482 application has been moved by the applicants challenging the proceedings of Criminal Case No. 17721 of 2019 'State vs. Neetu Gaur and Others' arising out of Case Crime No.
0056 of 2018 peding in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Haridwar, wherein, the present applicants have been chargesheeted and summoned for the offences punishable under Sections 120 B, 323, 420, 467, 468, 471, 504 and 506 of IPC P.S. Kotwali Haridwar, District Haridwar.

entities.text: State vs. Neetu Gaur and Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
4. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicants that with malafide intent the present applicants have been implicated pursuant to the FIR lodged on 08.01.2018 bearing FIR No. 0056 of 2018 for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 323, 504 and 506 of IPC.
5.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicants that, in fact, the dispute in between the applicant and the complainant are purely civil in nature, which is evident from the fact that a civil suit was filed by the respondent/complainant bearing O.S. No. 88 of 2015 was filed for cancellation of sale deed dated 25.02.2015 in the court of Civil Judge (S.D.) Haridwar, wherein, all the persons against whom the FIR has been lodged were arrayed as defendants.

6. Learned counsel for the applicants Mr. Narendra Bali submits that subsequently an application was moved for withdrawal of the said suit and on the said application the Civil Judge (S.D.) on 29.01.2016 allowed the application with a cost of Rs. 200/- and the respondent/complainant was permitted to withdraw the said suit, the copy of which is enclosed at page-33.
Unknown vs Neetu on 7 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159750737/
1 7.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that with same set of allegations and the averments as made in the civil suit.
The FIR has been lodged after more than three years and on this FIR the investigation was done and the charge-sheet has been filed.
He submits that since the allegations are appears to be civil in nature, therefore, the proceedings be quashed.

8. Apart from this, he also submits that another co-accused Arun Kumar Nath also challenged the same proceeding in a separate C482 application i.e. 640 of 2020, wherein, the Coordinate Bench of this Court stayed the proceedings.
9. Learned A.G.A. Mr. Pratiroop Pandey accepts notice for respondent no. 1.
Learned counsel for the applicant take fresh steps to serve respondent no. 2.

11. List this matter on 12.11.2024 along with C482 No. 640 of 2020.
12.
In the meantime, further proceedings of Criminal Case No. 17721 of 2019 'State vs. Neetu Gaur and Others' pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate Haridwar shall remain stayed.
